name: createDeliverable
shortDescription: Creates a new deliverable, assigning it to a Stump participant within a specific category and Quadrant context.
description:
Overview

Creates a new Deliverable record, associating it with a User (Stump), a Category, a Quadrant, and a Molecule.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Stumps from the Responsibility and Deliverable Management UI, or by an AI agent, to define new tangible outputs. Parameters include name, description, dueDate, categoryId, quadrantId, moleculeId, and ownerStumpId (or ctx.user_id if Stump is calling).

Logic

  1. Determine ownerStumpId: if ctx.role is 'stump', use ctx.user_id; otherwise, use params.ownerStumpId and validate that params.ownerStumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  2. Validate that params.categoryId exists by querying the Category entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  3. Validate that params.quadrantId exists by querying the Quadrant entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  4. Validate that params.moleculeId exists by querying the Molecule entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  5. Create a new Deliverable record using ctx.data.create with name, description, dueDate, categoryId, quadrantId, moleculeId, idOfUser (the ownerStumpId), and assignedByUserId (from ctx.user_id).
  6. Audit-log the deliverable creation using ctx.audit.log, including the deliverable name and owner stump.
  7. Return the created Deliverable record.

Entities

  • Deliverable
  • User
  • Category
  • Quadrant
  • Molecule
